openings.claim: Historical assignment selection may omit courses; renames may cause apparent omissions.
openings.discriminator: Membership changes versus changed coordinator judgments with membership fixed.
openings.probe: Vary assignment and name independently in fabricated staging against agreed weekly membership.
openings.uncertainty: Correlation is not causation; historical data and correction feasibility unknown.

openings.claim: Immediate replacements may reduce delivery coordination work.
openings.discriminator: Active work falls versus checking/import effort persisting despite shorter waits.
openings.probe: Counterbalance ordinary requests and immediate availability across six coordinators’ two sessions; time requesting, checking, correction, download and import separately.
openings.uncertainty: Fabricated tasks may not transfer; waiting differs from handling.

openings.claim: Schedules and handwritten annotations may reconstruct historical intended membership.
openings.discriminator: Dated traces distinguish reassignment, rename and split versus current names only.
openings.probe: Inspect authorized traces with source/update times; reconstruct before viewing exports; translate supported cases into fabricated fixtures.
openings.uncertainty: History/completeness unknown; park disagreements and missing history as unresolved.

openings.claim: Completion traces may support private replacement readiness cues.
openings.discriminator: Completion-to-retrieval delay versus request-to-start delay or selection defects.
openings.probe: Collect request/start/completion/retrieval times; verify center/week/file association before fabricated cue trial.
openings.uncertainty: Timestamps, identifiers and artifact links unconfirmed; readiness cannot certify coverage.

decision: Diagnose before implementation. All probes share six engineer-days and existing hosting; preserve private center-scoped processing, documented CSV and concurrent attendance entry. Split-center isolation remains untested. Stipulated synthetic evidence establishes no success: require next-40 median handling <=12 minutes, >=95% intended coverage and zero cross-center records.
